CHIM Cached Connector v1.7.8 - Installation Instructions
========================================================

IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE INSTALLING
----------------------------------
This connector provides advanced caching, thinking/reasoning support,
flexible quality instruction control, true sentence-by-sentence streaming
for simple format, diary injection, and event-based diary generation.

v1.7.8 is compatible with CHIM 2.4.3+.

REQUIREMENTS
------------
- CHIM 2.4.3 or compatible version
- PHP 7.4 or higher
- OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini API access
- Write permissions to CHIM installation directory

INSTALLATION STEPS
------------------

1. BACKUP YOUR CURRENT INSTALLATION
   Before installing, backup these directories:
   - connector/
   - lib/
   - lib/core/
   - ui/core/
   - ui/core/tmpl/
   - conf/
   - prompts/

2. INSTALL CORE FILES (Required)
   Copy these files maintaining directory structure:

   connector/openrouterjsoncached.php
   connector/openrouterjsoncached_helpers.php
   conf/conf_schema.json
   lib/core/llm_connector.class.php
   ui/core/llm_connectors.php

3. INSTALL UPSTREAM OVERWRITES (Review first)
   These replace upstream CHIM 2.4.3 files. All modifications are
   clearly marked with BEGIN/END comments.

   lib/data_functions.php              (streaming + LOCATION_BLACKLIST + diary classifier)
   lib/chat_helper_functions.php       (PRESERVE_ASTERISKS + offerDiary)
   lib/dynamic_update_util.php         (event-based diary counter)
   prompts/dialogue_prompt.php         (minimize quality instructions)
   main.php                            (diary injection + event counter wiring)
   conf/conf.sample.php                (diary setting defaults)
   ui/global_settings.php              (save bug fix + connector compatibility filter)
   ui/core/core_profiles.php           (removes deprecated AUTO_DIARY_WAIT toggle)
   ui/core/tmpl/metadata_json_editor.php  (diary settings in profile editor)
   ui/core/tmpl/override_editor.php    (diary settings in NPC override editor)
   ui/core/npc_master.php              (diary settings in per-NPC overrides)

   If you have custom modifications to these files, review the
   marked sections and merge manually.

   NOTE on ui/global_settings.php:
   - Contains a fix for the settings save error suppression bug
     (upstream CHIM bug where @file_put_contents silently fails)
   - Contains compatibility filter preventing cached connector from
     being assigned to incompatible CORE_CONNECTOR types

   NOTE on diary overwrites (main.php, dynamic_update_util.php, etc.):
   - These are optional. Skip them if you don't want diary features.
   - If skipping diary files, also skip conf.sample.php, metadata_json_editor.php,
     and npc_master.php (or merge only the non-diary portions).

4. VERIFY INSTALLATION
   - Access CHIM web interface
   - Navigate to LLM Connectors configuration
   - Create or edit a connector
   - Select "openrouterjsoncached" from the Driver dropdown
   - Verify caching settings section appears
   - Version should display as v1.7.8

5. VERIFY DIARY FEATURES (if installed)
   - Navigate to Profiles and select a profile
   - Scroll to the Diary section
   - Verify new settings appear: Inject Diaries, Diary Threshold Modifier,
     Diary Min Age Hours, Diary Generation Mode, Diary Events Threshold
   - Navigate to NPC Master and edit an NPC
   - Verify the same diary settings appear in the per-NPC overrides section

6. CONFIGURE CONNECTOR
   a. Basic Settings:
      - Set connector name
      - Select service (OpenRouter/OpenAI/etc)
      - Enter API URL and credentials
      - Choose model

   b. Caching Settings:
      - Provider Caching Type: Select your provider
      - Response Format: Choose JSON or Simple
      - Uncached Dialogue Count: Default 4

   c. Thinking/Reasoning Settings:
      - Toggle Thinking: Check to enable reasoning
      - Thinking Tokens: Set max tokens (default 1000)
      - Effort Level: Choose minimal/low/medium/high

   d. Additional Settings:
      - Disable Refusal Filter: ON by default (recommended)
        Prevents false-positive response cutoffs for Gemini/Palmyra
      - Preserve Asterisk Content: OFF by default
        Keeps text between asterisks (strips * characters only)

   e. Quality Instructions:
      - Minimize Quality Instructions: ON by default for cached connector
        Uses shorter prompts for advanced models (token savings)

   f. Custom Instructions:
      - Custom System Instruction: Appears before dialogue history
      - Custom Last Instruction: Appears after dialogue history

7. CONFIGURE DIARY FEATURES (if installed)
   a. Profile-Level Settings (Profiles > edit > Diary section):
      - Inject Diaries: Enable/disable diary recall during dialogue (default: ON)
      - Diary Threshold Modifier: Adjust scoring sensitivity (default: 0.0)
        Positive = stricter matching, Negative = more permissive
      - Diary Min Age Hours: Minimum in-game hours before a diary entry
        can be recalled (default: 1). Prevents echoing very recent entries.
      - Diary Generation Mode: How diary generation is triggered
        * sleep_wait: Original behavior (on NPC sleep/wait events)
        * event_count: New behavior (after N qualifying events)
        * both: Both triggers active
      - Diary Events Threshold: Number of qualifying events before
        event-based diary generation triggers (default: 50)

   b. Per-NPC Overrides (NPC Master > edit NPC > Settings Overrides):
      - Any of the above settings can be overridden per-NPC
      - Useful for giving important NPCs lower thresholds or different modes

UPGRADING FROM v1.5.x (CHIM 2.3.3)
------------------------------------
v1.7.8 is the CHIM 2.4.3 compatible version. Key changes:
- All lib files synced with CHIM 2.4.3 upstream
- prompts/dialogue_prompt.php now a direct overwrite (simpler install)
- ui/global_settings.php now included (save bug fix + compatibility filter)
- ext/cached_connector/ and lib/reasoning_helpers.php no longer needed
- New diary injection and event-based generation features
- New upstream overwrites: main.php, dynamic_update_util.php,
  metadata_json_editor.php, override_editor.php, npc_master.php,
  core_profiles.php, conf.sample.php
- AUTO_DIARY_WAIT toggle removed (replaced by DIARY_GENERATION_MODE)
- Clear cache files (*.tmp) after upgrade

TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------

Issue: Responses cut off mid-sentence (Gemini, Palmyra)
Solution: Ensure "Disable Refusal Filter" is checked (ON).
The upstream refusal filter triggers on common RPG dialogue words.

Issue: Asterisk content stripped from output
Solution: Enable "Preserve Asterisk Content" in connector settings.

Issue: <think> or <thinking> tags appear in NPC dialogue
Solution: Ensure lib/reasoning_helpers.php is installed.
The connector loads it automatically.

Issue: "Minimize Quality Instructions" toggle not visible
Solution: Ensure prompts/dialogue_prompt.php is installed.

Issue: Fatal error on pages with location data
Solution: Ensure the modified lib/data_functions.php is installed.
This fixes an upstream LOCATION_BLACKLIST bug.

Issue: Settings save appears to succeed but changes don't persist
Solution: Install the modified ui/global_settings.php from this package.
It fixes an upstream CHIM bug where @file_put_contents silently fails
on permission errors. After installing, you'll see a red error banner
with the exact chmod command needed.

Issue: Diary entries not being injected during dialogue
Solution: Check that INJECT_DIARIES is enabled in the active profile.
Also verify that diary entries exist in memory_summary (the NPC must have
generated diaries previously via sleep/wait or event triggers).

Issue: Event-based diary generation not triggering
Solution: Check DIARY_GENERATION_MODE is set to "event_count" or "both".
Verify DIARY_EVENTS_THRESHOLD is reasonable (default 50). Check that
auto_diary_enabled is true for the NPC in NPC Master.

VERSION INFORMATION
-------------------
Package: CHIM Cached Connector v1.7.8
Release Date: 2026-04-23
CHIM Compatibility: 2.4.3+
